node.title: Re: Loading a part of the file to array using Tie::File
node.author: glasswalk3r
node.doctext:
Never tried to use [mod://Tie::File] myself, but AFAIK it is just convenience.

On the other hand, there are plenty of solutions for reading large files. The most simply of it is to rely on open and a while, like: my $large_file = '/tmp/some_large_file.txt'; open(my $in, '<', $large_file) or die "Cannot read $large_file: $!"; while (<$in>) { # do something with $_ } # close is optional once $in goes out of scope close($in)
